prompt_retry_policy.retry_trigger: request/transport failure, empty or unfinished output; MS/action budget validation failure; native semantic/parser retries otherwise unchanged
prompt_retry_policy.restart: only the failed prompt at the current game position, immediately; no whole-case or previous-stage replay
prompt_retry_policy.action_retry: keep the accepted MS and retry only action with the same remaining cap
prompt_retry_policy.budget: accepted MS + accepted action share configured cap (primary4096); failed-generation retries add fully recorded compute beyond that cap
prompt_retry_policy.exhausted: after two failed attempts abort only this case and continue remaining cases
prompt_retry_policy.report: one case result; preserve every physical prompt attempt, errors and all costs; incomplete utility remains missing
